open_function_group.name: Spindle drive and encoder interface unidentified
open_function_group.source_line: The owner reports using a Mesa 7i96 Ethernet card with a Dell Optiplex running Debian 10 and LinuxCNC 2.8. Initial X and Z motion was working. A later update says the PNCconf-generated setup had the limit switches and coolant pump working. The owner also retained the original spindle encoder, which they identify as single-ended: it had eight wires, four of which the owner says needed to be grounded. They changed Mesa jumpers according to the 7i96 manual and verified the encoder in HAL Show.
